label: Portrait Viewpoint
description: Framings for people — from full body to detail. Absorbs the classic boudoir shot list.

items.name: full-body
items.text: full-body shot, the entire figure in frame with breathing room, camera at chest height so proportions stay true from head to feet

items.name: three-quarter-figure
items.text: three-quarter figure shot framed from head to mid-thigh, the crop falling between joints so the figure reads whole

items.name: waist-up
items.text: waist-up medium shot, natural conversational framing with the hands free to enter the frame

items.name: bust-portrait
items.text: classic head-and-shoulders portrait framing, headroom tight and the eyes on the upper third line

items.name: close-up-face
items.text: intimate close-up of the face, focus nailed to the nearest eye, lips and lashes drifting soft behind the focus plane

items.name: extreme-detail
items.text: extreme close-up detail shot, lips, lashes or laced fingers filling the whole frame, the focus plane a millimeter deep

items.name: over-the-shoulder
items.text: over-the-shoulder framing, the subject glancing back toward the viewer, the near shoulder soft in the foreground

items.name: profile
items.text: clean side profile, features rendered in silhouette-sharp relief against a simple ground

items.name: back-view
items.text: view from directly behind, the line of spine and shoulders leading the eye up to the turn of the head

items.name: mirror-shot
items.text: composed through a mirror, subject and reflection sharing the frame, focus committed to the reflection while the near shoulder blurs

items.name: doorway-frame
items.text: framed through a doorway, architecture bracketing the figure

items.name: lying-overhead
items.text: directly overhead looking down at the reclining subject, hair fanned across the surface below

items.name: low-hero-angle
items.text: camera just below chin height looking slightly up, the jawline strengthened and the figure lent quiet authority

items.name: high-beauty-angle
items.text: camera a hand's width above eye level angled gently down, the eyes enlarged and the jaw slimmed, the classic beauty angle

items.name: fashion-full-length
items.text: full-length fashion framing with the camera dropped to hip height, the subtle up-angle lengthening the legs and setting the figure against more sky than floor
